limitations: These are teaching coupons and input parsers, not a general scan-to-part optimizer.
TPMS functions are dimensionless Fourier nodal approximations, then re-distanced at0.2 mm voxel resolution.
The conservative width lower bound is one known nodal normal sampled at0.05 mm; it is not global wall-thickness proof. All12 measured lower bounds are1.0 mm within prescribed voxel error tolerance.
Analytic conical slope and finite-grid void connectivity do not establish support-free printing or physical powder evacuation.
Point-normal convex halfspaces and unsigned XYZ splats do not implement full calibrated Curless-Levoy range fusion.
Nominal minimum wall assumptions do not solve Mercelis-Kruth residual stress, material strength, fatigue, dimensional fidelity or machine qualification.
Teacher validation does not demonstrate that trained model outputs compile or generalize.
